caption: A person jumps down from a low garden wall, lands on both feet and bends deeply at the knees, then straightens up and walks on.

sa.check: A person jumps down from a low garden wall.
They bend deeply at the knees.
They straighten up and walk on.
The jump comes first, then the landing, then the bend, then walking on.

pc.expect: They fall faster to the ground, the knees bend on landing, and the body sinks before rising again.
pc.fail: They float down; or land stiff-legged; or bounce back up onto the wall.

pc.expect: They go forward off the wall, land ahead of it, and walk on.
pc.fail: They go backward; or land back on the wall; or freeze.

pc.expect: The body bends at the joints.
pc.fail: It folds mid-bone; or a limb detaches; or a leg stretches.

pc.expect: The feet land on the ground.
pc.fail: They sink; or pass through the wall; or the ground passes through them.

pc.expect: Their limbs keep their number and stay attached.
pc.fail: A limb vanishes; or a second figure appears; or they merge with the wall.

pc.expect: Their clothing and the garden stay the same.
pc.fail: The clothing changes colour; or the wall changes; or the garden rearranges.

note: Biomechanics scene: the body is the physics. Form, posture and skill are not judged; only that limbs stay attached, bend at joints, keep ground contact and pass through nothing.
